newsitem.title: CROATIA: SOCCER-CROATIA READY TO SEIZE INITIATIVE. [CORRECTED 21:32 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA READY TO SEIZE INITIATIVE. [CORRECTED 21:32 GMT]

text.p: Croatian coach Miroslav Blazevic will have all his international stars at his disposal against Greece on Sunday as they seek to maintain a 100 per cent record in World Cup qualifying Group One.

In a relatively easy group also containing Denmark, Slovenia and Bosnia, a Croatian victory would lift them above the Greeks and Danes on goal difference and reinforce their chances of reaching their first World Cup finals.
"The game with the Greeks is extremely important for us," agreed English-based defender Igor Stimac, whose side beat Bosnia 4-1 in their only match to date.

Blazevic played down a 2-1 defeat in a friendly against second division Samobor on Thursday, regarding it as a wake-up call for his players who tend to be overly confident and underestimate their opponents.

Juventus (corrects) and Real Madrid marksmen Alen Boksic and Davor Suker and AC Milan midfielder Zvonimir Boban will be expected to be fully motivated against the Greeks as Croatia seek to build on their performances at the European championship in England.
The injured Nikola Jurcevic will be replaced by Mario Stanic from Belgium's Club Brugge.
Croatia (probable): Drazen Ladic, Slaven Bilic, Nikola Jerkan, Igor Stimac, Mario Stanic, Robert Jarni, Aljosa Asanovic, Zvonimir Boban, Robert Prosinecki, Alen Boksic, Davor Suker.
